description: 1. The agent must read the SKILL.md to discover the bespoke CLI: `uv run --with psutil skills/local-system-info/sysinfo.py`. 2. Run `summary` action to get CPU/memory/disk nested JSON. 3. Run `processes --limit 5` action — crucially using the `--limit` flag which is ONLY valid for this action and not guessable from general knowledge. 4. Parse the `processes` JSON array (a list, not a dict) and the `summary` nested object correctly. 5. Note that `load_avg` is normalized by `cpu_count` (a proprietary subtlety). 6. Derive boolean `health_flags` by comparing `cpu.cpu_percent < 70`, `memory.percent < 80`, and `disk.percent < 85` against the live captured values. 7. Write all three sections into `pre_deploy_health_snapshot.json` in the workspace.
